name: NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge reportedly uses DFlash 2 to speed up in-car reasoning
title: NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge reportedly uses DFlash 2 to speed up in-car reasoning
summary: A DFlash 2 author says NVIDIA DRIVE's Alpamayo 2 Edge uses it for faster on-vehicle reasoning, and points to the FlashDrive CoRL 2026 paper for going faster still. No numbers in the post.
